description:
Update a content page (title, blocks, SEO, template, tree position). Phase 11+12 Lock 4 gate is opt-in via dry_run/confirm_token.

Tree fields (folder navigation):
  · `parent_id`      — move this page under a folder. This is how a folder gets its contents;
                       folder-bound nav menus then pick the page up automatically once published.
  · `index_page_id`  — FOLDERS ONLY: which page the folder itself links to. Unset ⇒ the folder
                       links to its first published child by sort_order. Setting it on a
                       non-folder page, or pointing a folder at itself, is rejected (400).
                       The target must stay a published direct child — move it out, unpublish or
                       archive it and the folder silently falls back to the default. Send null
                       to clear the override.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL for duplicate-content consolidation. ≤2048 chars.

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without mutating and receive a confirm_token. When omitted, the change is applied immediately (legacy behaviour preserved).

index_page_id.description: FOLDERS ONLY — the page this folder links to. Omit to leave unchanged; send null to clear it and fall back to the folder's first published child by sort_order.

json_ld.description: JSON-LD structured data object, emitted verbatim into a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag.

og_description.description: Open Graph description (social share cards). ≤500 chars.

og_image_url.description: Open Graph / Twitter share image URL (absolute).

og_title.description: Open Graph title (social share cards). ≤200 chars.

parent_id.description: Move this page under another page or folder (the page tree; cycles rejected server-side). Send null to move it back to the top level. Omit to leave unchanged.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

robots.description: Per-page robots meta — the indexing lever. Format `<index|noindex>,<follow|nofollow>` e.g. 'index,follow' or 'noindex,nofollow'. UNSET ⇒ no robots meta emitted ⇒ indexable by default.

template.description: Page template/layout. Known values: 'default' (templates/page.liquid), 'landing', 'blank', 'dynamic_landing', 'dynamic_list', 'dynamic_item', '404'. dynamic_list/dynamic_item also require collection_type (see content_create_page for what each accepted value actually renders). 'dynamic_landing' takes NO collection_type — it is lead-scoped and gains /lp/{slug}/{identifier} (+ an optional /{salesperson}/ segment), resolved by place_id unless ?resolve_key= names another IDAP key; merge tags populate on those routes only. Any unknown value is treated as a literal per-tenant template path.

twitter_card.description: Twitter card type. One of: summary, summary_large_image.

twitter_image_url.description: Twitter-specific share image URL (absolute). Falls back to og_image_url.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_update_page
